A repair job at the bike shop moves through these states:

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> JobOpened : Bike dropped off
    JobOpened --> AwaitingQuote : Quote needed
    AwaitingQuote --> JobApproved : Customer accepts
    JobOpened --> JobApproved : Fixed-price service
    JobApproved --> Cancelled : Customer declines or no reply
    JobApproved --> Diagnosis : Strip, inspect, note parts
    Diagnosis --> PartsReady : Parts ordered & arrived
    PartsReady --> InRepair : Mechanic starts
    InRepair --> InRepair : Extra adjustments
    InRepair --> TestRide : Work finished
    TestRide --> Ready : Rides smooth
    TestRide --> TestFailed : Noise, slip or wobble
    TestFailed --> TestRide : Readjusted
    TestFailed --> OnHold : Part faulty again
    TestFailed --> SupplierIssue : Wrong part supplied
    SupplierIssue --> InRepair : Right part arrived
    SupplierIssue --> OnHold : Part discontinued
    OnHold --> TestRide : Workaround fitted
    OnHold --> ReturnedUnfixed : Customer collects as is
    Ready --> [*]
    ReturnedUnfixed --> Refunded
    Cancelled --> [*]
    Refunded --> [*]
```

Most jobs pass the test ride the first time.
